mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, it is 65 degrees at Verona City Hall under clear skies, with an air quality index of 61. We have a waxing gibbous moon tonight, and you can spot the ISS passing overhead for three minutes starting at 5:47 AM, moving from the west-northwest over Cross Plains toward the northeast near the Madison Home Depot. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain forecast.

The City of Verona has several items on the agenda for the November 4th Plan Commission meeting at 6:30 PM. Projects under review include the Ardent Glen addition, certified survey maps for Jenna Drive and Range Trail, and a site plan for 1979 Milky Way. Residents are encouraged to sign up for development updates on the city website.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can attend yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy Thursday night activities at ART House, or join in for trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, the Dane County Farmers' Market returns to the Capitol Square this Saturday.

In a report from Thursday, October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I following reports of erratic driving. Officers located the bus near the intersection of Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace, and while the driver was taken for testing, no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the rich Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
